rules: A state outside state_vocabulary is a defect, not a nuance. nfl/WORK_QUEUE.md currently carries three rows reading 'DONE (2026-09-20)' and agent_state raises on them -- do not repeat that here.
blocked_by names the thing that must finish first, by id or by a code an agent can grep for. 'Blocked' with no cause is not a state.
DONE requires a commit sha. A task marked done with no artifact is a claim, not a record.
An item an agent decided for itself goes in with owner and rationale. An item the owner ruled goes in OWNER_DECISIONS.md first and is referenced from here.

items.title: REPLAY_RE_SELECTS: replay must consume the sealed input set
items.detail: The seal records an input set and nothing can consume it, so every replay re-selects against today's manifest. Sealed source identities explicit; exact raw artifact hashes consumed; missing sealed inputs fail closed; current availability cannot substitute; sources added after the historical run cannot enter replay.
items.acceptance: negative fixture: historical seal A plus a current manifest containing newer source B -> replay consumes A only

items.title: Orchestration so the conservation bridge is production-reachable
items.detail: run_chain.run has NO caller outside its own CLI, so nothing places a bridge artifact beside a forecast review. The carrier exists and is wired; the orchestration does not.
items.constraint: The orchestrator may transport the governed result. The authoritative producer remains the existing conservation owner. Do not create a second authority.

items.title: Restore OPPORTUNITY_CONSERVATION_FAILURE and OPPORTUNITY_CONSUMER_OUT_OF_SCOPE to ADVERTISED
items.acceptance: producer exists AND production executes it AND evidence survives transport AND review consumes the stored governed result AND NOT_CHECKED blocks AND a corrupted fixture fails end to end

items.title: Wire forbidden-external-input integrity
items.detail: pipeline.assert_no_postgame_inputs runs and refuses a stage declaring a postgame field; adjustment_registry refuses an undeclared re-application. Neither reaches the gate.

items.title: Wire unresolved inactive-identity integrity
items.detail: player_universe classifies an unresolvable row IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED and inactives.resolve refuses an ambiguous name. Neither result is surfaced as a finding, so a slate where an inactive could not be attached to a named player reads the same as one where every name resolved.

items.title: usage_vintage.py reads a vintage it never declared
items.detail: Leakage-adjacent. Classify exactly: undeclared source read / declaration drift / parser mismatch / manifest mismatch / other. Then ensure every consumed vintage is in the governed declared input set.
items.constraint: Do NOT regenerate the p7 inventory away -- UNDECLARED_VINTAGE_READ is not regenerable and the inventory refresh would erase the evidence.

items.title: SURVIVORSHIP_AUDIT.json 22,821 vs measured 22,037
items.detail: Determine whether the difference is changed corpus, changed measurement, changed eligibility, changed artifact or stale completed-task output. Do not overwrite the old audit. Return whether FIN-2 remains valid, stale, or requires re-sealing.
items.note: A task marked DONE cannot silently retain an audit artifact that no longer reproduces its own measurement.

items.title: Verify or refute the detbuf conservation failures
items.detail: test_detbuf_conservation, newly visible, reports passing yards != receiving yards in 7,996 of 8,000 draws (worst 1.29e+03) and passing TD != receiving TD in 6,103 of 8,000 on pre_inactives_V1_CANDIDATE_R9_W1P_GA/117a78668a0b7a0e.
items.caution: The module's own docstring records TWO earlier misreads of the row mapping. This is not a defect until independently checked.

items.title: Three remaining UNKNOWN red modules
items.detail: test_execution_identity, test_inactives_substance, test_q9_live_feature_builder. inactives_substance and capture_obligations both report 20 game-anchored rows uncredited against an expected 18 -- the same +2 drift, so they probably share a root.

items.title: HistoricalArtifactManifest vertical slice
items.detail: One 2023 regular-season game. Choose the game and resolve kickoff BEFORE defining cuts -- every cut must precede kickoff, and a Thursday game gets Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/T-90, not Friday/Sunday. PIT decisions are artifact x cut. first_observed_at stays distinct from source_published_at.

items.title: SimulationCalibration A/B/C/D
items.detail: A independent calibrated marginals, B shared game/team factors, C hierarchical opportunity worlds, D drive-conditioned challenger ONLY if needed.
registered_requirements: first question is whether one simulation column is a coherent shared football world across players
marginal CRPS, randomized PIT, accounting invariants, energy score, variogram score, prespecified joint-exceedance events
variogram score is a required DIAGNOSTIC, never a standalone promotion criterion
deterministic hierarchical RNG streams: slate_seed, game_seed(world), team_seed(world, team), component_seed(world, component)
